verdict.rationale: Running vision-language models is a fair question for a local and cloud LLM chat app like Jan, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions image input, multimodal or vision models, or attaching images to chats. The references to Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GGUF import and cloud providers are about text LLMs only, so this capability is unevidenced.
